notes: The breadboard image is drawn with the top half's rows labelled j-f (nearest the top rail), so the top-half holes are named here as bank 'b' (rows f-j) in catalogue terms. Rails: the red + rail row is tp and the black - rail row is tn.

Exact hole columns are read from the image: the photoresistor spans columns 6 and 10 in row g, the 10k resistor spans columns 10 and 13 in row h, the blue A0 wire lands in column 10, the short red wire goes from the + rail to column 6, and the short black wire goes from column 13 to the - rail. The photoresistor and resistor therefore meet at column 10 (the divider midpoint, wired to A0).
Rail columns for the long red and black wires are approximate (tp.2 and tn.4). Rail holes are assumed to be unsplit single strips as in the catalogue.
The resistor is 10 kΩ per the schematic and the text; the 'value' prop is given in ohms (10000).
The Arduino GND used is the second GND pin in the power header (GND.2). The first GND pin is GND.1 and is not used.
The photoresistor is symmetric, so its two legs are assigned to columns 6 and 10 arbitrarily. The software side (code) is not part of the graph.
